summary: TetrisVerse Android app project with Google AdMob integration. User needs an app-ads.txt hosting solution on Internet Computer to pass AdMob app verification. Publisher ID: pub-7936595519986908.
architectural_notes: Site must serve app-ads.txt at the root domain for AdMob verification
known_issues: Google AdMob cannot verify TetrisVerse (Android) app due to missing/invalid app-ads.txt file
imageRequirements:
## Required Images
- TetrisVerse logo mark with colorful falling tetromino blocks on a dark background (tetrisverse-logo.dim_400x200.png)

existing_features.title: Create a minimal frontend that serves the app-ads.txt content at the path `/app-ads.txt`. When a browser or crawler navigates to `/app-ads.txt`, it must return the plain text content: `google.com, pub-7936595519986908, DIRECT, f08c47fec0942fa0` with the correct MIME type `text/plain`.

Create a simple, clean landing page as the home route (`/`) that explains this site is the official developer website for TetrisVerse and that the app-ads.txt file is hosted here for Google AdMob verification. Include a visible link to `/app-ads.txt`.

Apply a clean, game-inspired visual theme to the landing page — dark background with bright accent colors, bold typography, and a minimal layout that reflects a mobile gaming brand identity. Keep it consistent throughout.

new_feature_requests.summary: Create a simple web app that serves app-ads.txt at the root URL for Google AdMob verification (pub-7936595519986908)
